# LifeKernelOS

> AI-native personal operating system. The product keeps multiple mainline groups, helps a user confirm one current To-do, derives progress from completed To-dos, and aggregates user-confirmed facts into a profile. Human decisions override every document below.

## Start here

- [Agent operating guide](AGENTS.md): mandatory reading order, fact-source precedence, change rules, and verification protocol.
- [Documentation map](docs/README.md): routes a task to its single authoritative document domain.
- [Project overview](README.md): product summary, current implementation status, and local verification commands.

## Current product facts

- [Product entry](docs/product/README.md): product-document scope and update rules.
- [PRD v0.11](docs/product/PRD.md): confirmed goal-driven positioning, mainlines, To-dos, calendar, profile facts, BYOK AI decomposition, and acceptance criteria.
- [ADR-0008: mainline groups and derived To-do progress](docs/architecture/decisions/0008-mainline-groups-derived-todo-progress.md): current core domain decision.
- [ADR-0007: two-tab console](docs/architecture/decisions/0007-two-tab-console-information-architecture.md): current information architecture decision.
- [SPEC-0010: mainline To-dos and current action](docs/specs/current/0010-long-term-goals-and-current-action.md): executable contract for the “主线” tab.
- [SPEC-0011: progress-aware profile graph](docs/specs/current/0011-aggregated-profile-graph.md): executable contract for the “我的画像” tab.

- [Basic Todo and calendar](docs/specs/current/0013-basic-todo-and-calendar.md): direct completion, undo, recoverable removal, civil dates, list/today/month/week views.
- [Todo experience references](docs/product/todo-reference-products.md): official product sources and adopted interaction rules.

- [BYOK task decomposition](docs/specs/current/0014-byok-ai-task-decomposition.md): client Key configuration, explicit generation, editable suggestions, transactional apply and guarded undo.
- [ADR-0012](docs/architecture/decisions/0012-local-byok-ai.md): main-process secret storage and compatible text-model transport.

## Product direction proposal

- [PRD v0.11 draft](docs/product/next-direction-prd.md): Goal-driven positioning and BYOK decomposition have been accepted in the current PRD. Progressive display, factual review and profile changes remain Proposed.
- [ADR-0011](docs/architecture/decisions/0011-progressive-action-workspace.md): Proposed progressive display across task and profile views. Review and accept the affected specs before implementation.

## Architecture and delivery facts

- [Architecture entry](docs/architecture/README.md): architecture-document scope and ADR routing.
- [System architecture](docs/architecture/system-architecture.md): system boundaries, domain model, module ownership, and persistence rules.
- [Technical design](docs/architecture/technical-design.md): migrations, DTOs, transactions, API contract, and implementation constraints.
- [ADR index](docs/architecture/decisions/README.md): all decisions and their lifecycle states.
- [Spec index](docs/specs/README.md): current, foundation, backlog, and archive specification routing.
- [Identity and server persistence](docs/specs/foundation/0008-identity-and-server-persistence.md): authentication, sessions, isolation, and server fact-source contract.
- [Data export](docs/specs/foundation/0007-data-export-and-clear.md): schemaVersion 7 export contract including Captures and calendar dates; v6 desktop import remains compatible.
- [Development entry](docs/development/README.md): delivery-document scope.
- [AI-native SDD protocol](docs/development/SDD.md): lifecycle, change classification, and evidence requirements.

- [Electron desktop](docs/specs/current/0012-electron-desktop.md): local identity, utility-process SQLite, guarded multi-window mutations, backup/import and desktop UX.
- [ADR-0009](docs/architecture/decisions/0009-electron-local-desktop.md): accepted Electron local desktop decision, superseding default server deployment.

- [ADR-0010](docs/architecture/decisions/0010-todo-calendar-views.md): one task fact source across date views.
- [CI/CD](docs/development/ci-cd.md): automatic desktop checks, installer artifacts and version-tag releases.

## Repository boundaries

- `sources/` is synchronized read-only reference material. Do not edit, move, rename, or delete it.
- Do not infer a third primary tab, a single unique mainline, manual progress percentages, or personality/capability inference. The current product has only “主线” and “我的画像”; settings is an auxiliary workspace entry.
- Before changing behavior, locate the owning Product, ADR, and Spec document through the routes above. After changes, run `npm run docs:check` and relevant tests.
